description: A production-ready .NET client for the Google Gemini API: resilient (retries + rate limiting), observable, and DI-native, with first-class ASP.NET Core ergonomics. Built with AI: the v6 modernization was implemented end-to-end by Claude (Anthropic) — see the README.
releaseNotes:
6.2.0: adds cost governance -- as far as we've found, no other .NET Gemini client library
			offers this (checked nine, including Google's own official SDK; see
			docs/articles/cost-governance.md). New GeminiOptions.Budget (BudgetOptions) configures:
			(1) a cumulative daily USD ceiling (MaxCostPerDayUsd): once today's (UTC) real recorded
			spend reaches it, the next call throws the new GeminiBudgetExceededException before being
			sent -- no network round-trip, no cost from the rejected call itself; and (2) an opt-in
			best-effort per-request estimate ceiling (MaxCostPerRequestUsd): spends one exact
			CountTokensAsync round-trip (skipped entirely, zero overhead, when this is unset) to bound
			input cost precisely, bounds output cost only when the request sets MaxTokens (widened by a
			positive ThinkingBudget), and throws the new GeminiRequestCostExceededException if the
			estimate exceeds the ceiling -- covers GenerateAsync/GenerateWithImageAsync/ChatAsync(
			MessageObject[]) and their streaming counterparts; not ChatAsync(IList<Content>), since
			there's no token-counting endpoint for a raw Content list. Every call's real UsageMetadata is
			priced (built-in rates for the current model lineup, overridable per-model via
			BudgetOptions.ModelPricingOverrides) and recorded as the new gemini.client.cost.usd
			OpenTelemetry counter, matching the existing token/duration metric pattern, regardless of
			whether enforcement is enabled. Covers both PostAsync and StreamAsync (a runaway streaming
			loop is now budget-checked too, closing a gap where cost governance would otherwise be
			silently bypassable via StreamAsync/StreamChatAsync). Cost accounting correctly bills
			"thinking" tokens as output and discounts cached-content tokens at the cached rate without
			double-charging them. Tracking is in-memory and per-process only -- see the new
			docs/articles/cost-governance.md for the multi-instance caveat and every other limitation
			(they're documented precisely, not glossed over). Also fixes a bug found while building
			this: IGeminiService.CountTokensAsync(prompt, ct) had no way to specify a model and always
			resolved against DefaultModel even when a caller intended a different one; new 3-arg
			overloads (CountTokensAsync/CountTokensWithImageAsync/CountTokensChatAsync, all taking
			GeminiRequestOptions?) resolve against options.Model instead. No breaking changes.
			6.1.0: fixes a client-side bug that rejects valid API keys. IsValidApiKeyFormat was
			locked to the legacy "AIza"/"BIza"/"CIza" prefixes; Google has since introduced a new "AQ."
			key format (rolling out through Sep 2026, after which "AIza" keys stop working entirely) that
			the old check rejected before the request ever reached the network. The check no longer
			gatekeeps on prefix -- it only catches empty/too-short/whitespace-corrupted values. This bug
			affects the previous 6.0.1 release too; consider it the reason to upgrade even if you don't
			need the feature below.
			Also adds image generation. New GenerateImageAsync(prompt, options?, ct) on
			IGeminiService — defaults to Models.RecommendedImage and TEXT+IMAGE response modalities,
			overridable via GeminiRequestOptions.Model/ResponseModalities. New response accessors
			Images()/TryGetImages()/GetImagesOrThrow() on GenerateContentResponse, mirroring the
			existing Text() trio, returning already-decoded GeneratedImage (MimeType + byte[] Data).
			New GeminiRequestOptions.ImageAspectRatio/ImageSize (Gemini 3+ image models) plus the
			backing GeminiConstants.ResponseModalities/ImageAspectRatios/ImageSizes constants. Live-
			verified against the real API: default generation, explicit aspect ratio/resolution
			(confirmed by decoding the returned image's actual pixel dimensions), and image-only output.
			No breaking changes; no streaming image generation yet.
			6.0.1: refreshed for Google's July 2026 model release. Added gemini-3.6-flash and
			gemini-3.5-flash-lite constants; Models.Recommended/Defaults.Model now point to
			gemini-3.6-flash and Models.Fastest to gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Note: Google deprecated
			temperature/topP/topK on these two new models (ignored now, will 400 in a future
			generation) — see the XML docs on GenerationConfig and GeminiRequestOptions for guidance
			(use SystemInstruction for determinism instead). No breaking changes.
			6.0.0: a ground-up modernization of the v5 client — resilient (correct retry/backoff +
			client-side rate limiting), observable (OpenTelemetry traces & metrics), DI-native, with
			generic structured output (GenerateAsync<T>), the full modern Gemini surface including
			Gemini 3 (function calling with thoughtSignature replay, thinkingLevel, grounding, Files,
			caching), Microsoft.Extensions.AI adapters (IChatClient/IEmbeddingGenerator), and a
			netstandard2.0 build verified on .NET Framework 4.8. See the v5-to-v6 migration guide.
			6.0.0-rc.1: release candidate for 6.0.0. The v6 surface is feature-complete and verified
			live against the Gemini API — Gemini 3 function calling with thoughtSignature replay,
			grounding, Files API, embeddings, structured output, streaming, and IChatClient — and the
			netstandard2.0 build is verified running on .NET Framework 4.8. No further API changes are
			planned before 6.0.0; please report any issues.
			6.0 beta.4: fix netstandard2.0 usage on .NET Framework. AddGemini's options validation
			needs System.ComponentModel.Annotations, which the .NET Framework GAC ships at an older
			version than required — so it's now declared as a netstandard2.0 dependency and deployed
			automatically (previously threw FileNotFoundException on first use). Verified live on
			.NET Framework 4.8. .NET Framework consumers should also enable AutoGenerateBindingRedirects.
			6.0 beta.3: default request timeout raised from 30s to 100s. Gemini 3 "thinking" models
			default to high reasoning depth and a single call can take well over a minute; the old
			30s default caused spurious GeminiTimeoutExceptions. (Lower TimeoutSeconds, or set a lower
			ThinkingLevel, for latency-sensitive workloads.)
			6.0 beta.2: Gemini 3 support and correctness.
			- Models are no longer validated against a hardcoded allow-list, so Gemini 3.x (and any future
			  model) work without a library update; added Gemini 3 model constants and made a current GA
			  model the default.
			- thinkingLevel (Gemini 3) alongside thinkingBudget (mutually exclusive, guarded); mediaResolution;
			  thoughtSignature captured on response parts and echoable via a new Content-based ChatAsync/
			  StreamChatAsync overload (required for Gemini 3 multi-turn function calling).
			- No longer forces a default temperature, per Gemini 3 guidance to keep it at the model default.
			6.0 beta.1: the core surface is now validated end-to-end against the live Gemini API
			(text, structured output, streaming, embeddings, token counting, model listing, IChatClient,
			and error mapping). Feature-complete and validated; still a prerelease while extended
			features (Files, caching, grounding) and real-world usage are exercised before stable.
			alpha.4 added a netstandard2.0 target for maximum reach (.NET Framework 4.6.1+, Mono,
			Unity, Xamarin), using polyfills and a built-in retry handler where the modern resilience
			package isn't available.
			alpha.3 added the differentiation layer on top of the modern feature set:
			- Microsoft.Extensions.AI adapters (IChatClient / IEmbeddingGenerator) via the
			  companion package Junaid.GoogleGemini.Net.Extensions.AI.
			- OpenTelemetry-native tracing + token/latency metrics (GenAI semantic conventions),
			  with no OpenTelemetry dependency — opt in via AddSource/AddMeter("Junaid.GoogleGemini.Net").
			Earlier 6.0 alphas delivered: correct retries/streaming/serialization/typed errors (Phase 1)
			and the modern API — structured output GenerateAsync<T>, system instructions, thinking,
			tools/grounding, Files API, context caching (Phase 2).
title: Junaid.GoogleGemini.Net
